title: Intern/Working Student Legal - German Speaking (all genders)
announcement: Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Your future team Your reach will cover the entire Holidu Group (700+ employees), while your day-to-day will be embedded within the Finance department, a team of 30+ colleagues. With us, you’ll experience how Legal at Holidu is not only a safeguard, but also an enabler of success – and you’ll have fun along the way. Team spirit, motivation, and self-responsibility. What we offer Impact : Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact. Learning : Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI. Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing. Technology : Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously. Flexibility : Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices. Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way. source_record.description:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

Your reach will cover the entire Holidu Group (700+ employees), while your day-to-day will be embedded within the Finance department, a team of 30+ colleagues. We are passionate about working hard towards our goals, but we also know how to have fun and enjoy time together outside the office with our regular team events. A key sparring partner for you will be our Legal Counsel, while reporting directly to our Head of Legal. At Holidu, Legal is all about teamwork: we support each other, share knowledge, and celebrate successes together.

As part of our team, you will gain hands-on insights into a broad range of legal topics – from compliance and data privacy to contract management and legal operations. You won’t just watch from the sidelines: you’ll actively contribute to real projects and see how legal topics impact a fast-growing international business.
What makes us different? We truly care about development. You will be encouraged to ask questions, bring in your ideas, and grow your skills step by step. With us, you’ll experience how Legal at Holidu is not only a safeguard, but also an enabler of success – and you’ll have fun along the way.

This position is available as either a full-time internship (40 hours per week) or part-time as a Working Student (20 hours per week).
The starting date is planned for January 2027.

What you will do

  • Support our Legal Department in legal operations and gain valuable hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment.

  • Conduct contract management: review, classify and structure contracts.

  • Assist the legal department with drafting and revising contracts.

  • Handle data protection issues.

  • Work on national and international projects.

What you bring

  • You are a business-law/law student or Referendar.

  • Strong commercial background and business acumen.

  • In addition to an independent, proactive and very conscientious way of working, you are highly structured.

  • Excellent English and German language skills.

  • High work precision and attention to detail.

  • Team spirit, motivation, and self-responsibility.

What we offer

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.

  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.

  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.

  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.

  • Flexibility: Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.

  • Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

Life at Holidu
Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholidu and see also what the Life as an intern looks like at Holidu!

Apply now!

Apply online on our career page! Your first travel contact will be Sabrina from HR.
We are committed to diversity in all aspects of our business. We encourage applications from all genders, all corners of the world and all individual backgrounds. You are welcome to submit your application without a photo and without stating your gender, date of birth, marital status, nationality or disability status (if applicable).
